text: Machine learning is a type of technology that allows computers to learn from data without being directly programmed. In supervised learning, a computer is given training data, which includes examples with correct answers. The computer uses this data to build a model, a kind of mathematical rule. After training, the model can make predictions about new information it has never seen before. For example, it can predict whether an email is spam or not. The quality of a model is measured by its accuracy, which means how often its predictions are correct. More and better training data usually leads to more accurate predictions.
